# NN domaiNN

## NN domaiNN: Procedure Console E2E
knowledge_dir:: kNNowledge/
blueprints_dir:: specs/bluepriNNts/
The domaiNN `test/ui/procedure_console_e2e.py` copies to a scratch folder: one procedure with two engine steps, a human decision and two agent branches. The executions bluepriNNt is copied in from `iNNfo/specs/bluepriNNts/executions/` at run time, so it never drifts from the shipped one.
